title: Data for normalized completed coefficient comparisons
statement: Record the existing quotient ring tower n↦R/I^n with quotient transition maps, the constant ring functors at the point and on a scheme, and the map from constant scalars to continuous functions. Also record inverse-image coefficient inclusions, the restricted rational module and multiplication-by-l module sequence, the completed comparison predicate, the finite-subextension ring diagram and its canonical cocone, and the ZMod(l^n) quotient tower. These are exactly the previously declared constructions of Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleCompletedCoefficients, moved with their names and types preserved. All construction bodies are identical. The comparison predicate records rational pullback naturality through the underlying bundled coefficientPullbackIso maps: these are identity followed by the original condensedPullbackHom components, so the identity law gives the same condition. No alternative coefficient model is introduced. The underlying notions are [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and [sk-def-sfb-module-objects].
